title: Restoring Painting
statementMd:
Vasya works as a watchman in the gallery. Unfortunately, one of the most expensive paintings was stolen while he was on duty. He doesn't want to be fired, so he has to quickly restore the painting. He remembers some facts about it.

- The painting is a square $3 × 3$, each cell contains a single integer from $1$ to $*n*$, and different cells may contain either different or equal integers.
- The sum of integers in each of four squares $2 × 2$ is equal to the sum of integers in the top left square $2 × 2$.
- Four elements $*a*$, $*b*$, $*c*$ and $*d*$ are known and are located as shown on the picture below.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/69b6e71a30a43d62478f8c701eb83af65cae4c77.png)

Help Vasya find out the number of distinct squares the satisfy all the conditions above. Note, that this number may be equal to $0$, meaning Vasya remembers something wrong.

Two squares are considered to be different, if there exists a cell that contains two different integers in different squares.

## Input

The first line of the input contains five integers $*n*$, $*a*$, $*b*$, $*c*$ and $*d*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$, $1 ≤ *a*, *b*, *c*, *d* ≤ *n*$) — maximum possible value of an integer in the cell and four integers that Vasya remembers.

## Output

Print one integer — the number of distinct valid squares.

## Note

Below are all the possible paintings for the first sample. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1b080143491988c6341fdeec4f018af688f28dfb.png) ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6520e87d7d093e906e3728605d9f5db63de49200.png)

In the second sample, only paintings displayed below satisfy all the rules. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/755d6953bc72adb7d62919cdae44fe4df2a45980.png) ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9f7e753ea8e0a6f656ec97220ec4b15e1d5bc623.png) ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4089012b4c3887d273cb380d1fd0265b752984fb.png) ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/49ac2bae7fc7d6c4cae7402c6e654ecbd9d3711a.png) ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9e8fa53d16956a11eb7a1e22a078d3b2352a882c.png) ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/64bbe903c79c18fb251bd816e50940371e2da449.png)
statementZhMd:
瓦夏在画廊担任守卫。不幸的是，在他值班期间，一幅最昂贵的画作被盗了。他不想被解雇，因此必须尽快修复这幅画。他还记得关于这幅画的一些事实。

- 这幅画是一个 $3 × 3$ 的正方形，每个格子中包含一个从 $1$ 到 $*n*$ 的整数，不同格子中的整数可以不同，也可以相同。
- 四个 $2 × 2$ 正方形中每个正方形内的整数之和，都等于左上角 $2 × 2$ 正方形内的整数之和。
- 四个元素 $*a*$、$*b*$、$*c*$ 和 $*d*$ 已知，它们的位置如下图所示。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/69b6e71a30a43d62478f8c701eb83af65cae4c77.png)

请帮助瓦夏求出满足上述所有条件的不同正方形数量。注意，这个数量可能为 $0$，这意味着瓦夏记错了某些事情。

如果存在某个格子，使得两个正方形在该格子中包含的整数不同，则认为这两个正方形不同。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含五个整数 $*n*$、$*a*$、$*b*$、$*c*$ 和 $*d*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$，$1 ≤ *a*, *b*, *c*, *d* ≤ *n*$）——格子中整数的最大可能值，以及瓦夏记得的四个整数。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——不同的有效正方形数量。

## 说明

下面给出了第一个样例中所有可能的画作。
![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1b080143491988c6341fdeec4f018af688f28dfb.png) ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6520e87d7d093e906e3728605d9f5db63de49200.png)

在第二个样例中，只有下面展示的画作满足所有规则。
